name: CineFlags
meaning: Cine.flags +0x8b4 (Cine_Start arg 2). Default 0x0c000000 from Cine_Construct. Only bits read in this module are listed

name: CINE_REQUIRE_CONFIRM
meaning: start only on a confirm press edge (Pad_MenuPressed(0xBFFF)) while the Wolf is in ACTBOX; played is never set, so it can be replayed. Unused in retail data (no trigger in any WAR sets it)

name: CINE_CAM_CUT_IN
meaning: camera cuts into the cutscene instead of gliding: Cine::Update and Cine::RunOpcodes pass (~flags >> 1) & 3 as Camera_StartScripted's CAMSCR_BLEND_IN/BLEND_OUT bits (cine_update.cpp, cine2.cpp; camera.cpp), so a set bit clears BLEND_IN (verified)

name: CINE_CAM_CUT_OUT
meaning: camera cuts out of the cutscene instead of gliding: the same (~flags >> 1) & 3, bit 0x4 clears BLEND_OUT (verified)

name: CINE_RELATIVE_TO_WOLF
meaning: worldOffset = Wolf.pos - first position key of the Wolf's track; cleared if the Wolf has no position track

name: CINE_WOLF_NO_HANDSHAKE_MASK
meaning: either bit: the Wolf gets no msg 0x12 and wolfReady is set immediately (Cine_NotifyActors)

name: CINE_RESTORE_ACTORS
meaning: save actor pos/rot/visibility/anim at load, restore at finish

name: CINE_HAS_TEXT
meaning: CINnnTEXT is resolved with Text_GetClassString(manager) and passed as Cine_Start's text

name: CINE_NO_WOLF_FREEZE
meaning: no Wolf msg 0xe/0xf, and the skip-button test is skipped

name: CINE_NO_INPUT
meaning: Cine_Update skips all skip and dialogue handling

name: CINE_LEVEL_EXIT
meaning: Fade_StartLevelExit at endTriggerMs; sets g_levelExitFlags |= 1 in Cine_Finish

name: CINE_REPEATABLE
meaning: played is not set, so the trigger fires again whenever the Wolf is in ACTBOX with no cinematic active (8 triggers in Lvl-16, flags 0x680E/0x640E)

name: CINE_SUSPEND_ACTIVE_SCRIPT
meaning: saves 0x71cdb0 and zeroes it for the duration

name: CINE_SAVE_FIRST
meaning: first fire requests autosave (MCardManager msg 0x3500) or the save UI (msg 1) instead of starting; the cinematic starts once MCardManager reports idle. One retail trigger uses it: CIN01 of Fend's CinematicsManager, flags 0xD82E (the scene before Planet X); no level trigger does (verified by reading every WAR)

name: CINE_AUTO_SHEEP_BBOX
meaning: use the WAR_IDO_CINSHEEPBBOX export when no sheep box is passed

name: CINE_AUTO_CIN_BBOX
meaning: use the WAR_IDO_CINBBOX export when no box is passed
